Subject: Design QA ? Corrections
Comments:
Ground conductor connection shown on the single-line diagram (SLD) is incorrect. Downstream of the neutral-to-ground bond at the fused AC disconnect (ACD) for a supply-side connection, the ground conductor is a grounding electrode conductor (GEC) and must terminate directly at the grounding electrode (GE), not at the main service panel (MSP) ground bar.

GEC is typically a 6 AWG bare copper conductor, installed without conduit, running directly from the fused ACD to the grounding electrode. Please update the design template for supply-side connections to reflect the correct GEC routing and termination.

For this specific design, the interconnection can be simplified by revising to a 40A breaker in the existing 150A/150A MSP with PCS-BBoC enabled, eliminating the need for the current supply-side interconnection configuration. Include additional breakers on BOM for breaker consolidation to create space.
